1.name: Magical Trample
1.description: Pierce the air with a shrill whistle, calling your mount forth to trample enemies in a line. This ability cannot be re-activated while your mount is already attacking.

2.name: Rending Slashes
2.description:
Slice an enemy with both weapons to cause deep lacerations, dealing |cffffff1841|r Bleed Damage with each weapon and causing them to bleed for an additional |cffffff8410|r Bleed Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Enemies hit by the initial hit are afflicted with the Hemorrhaging status effect.

You also reduce their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

3.name: Quick Cloak
3.description:
Envelop yourself in a protective cloak of razors, gaining Major Evasion for |cffffff30|r seconds, reducing damage from area attacks by |cffffff20|r%. 

Every |cffffff2|r seconds the shrapnel will pulse, dealing |cffffff1080|r Physical Damage to all enemies within |cffffff5|r meters.

You also gain Major Expedition for |cffffff4|r seconds, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Gripping Shards
4.description:
Conjure icy shards around you to skewer enemies in the area, immobilizing them for |cffffff3|r seconds and dealing |cffffff955|r Frost Damage every |cffffff1|r second for |cffffff12|r seconds.

Enemies hit are overcome with bitter cold, reducing their Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff3|r seconds.

Damage done is based on your Max Health and has a higher chance to apply the Chilled status effect.

5.name: Flawless Dawnbreaker
5.description:
Arm yourself with Meridia's sacred sword and dispense her retribution, dealing |cffffff8557|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and an additional |cffffff9252|r Physical Damage over |cffffff6|r seconds.

After activating, your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff20|r seconds.

1.name: Absorb Missile
1.description:
Bolster your defenses, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10713|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

While the shield persists, you are healed for |cffffff4907|r Health the next time a harmful direct damage projectile hits you. This effect can occur once per cast.

This ability scales off your Max Health.

2.name: Shielded Assault
2.description:
Rush an enemy and ram them, dealing |cffffff3510|r Physical Damage and stunning them for |cffffff3|r seconds.

You automatically block all attacks at no cost for |cffffff0.5|r seconds after activating. When this ends, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff11066|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield strength scales off your Max Health.

3.name: Bone Surge
3.description:
Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff11066|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health.

An ally near you can activate the Spinal Surge synergy, granting up to |cffffff6|r allies a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff35|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff6|r seconds and Major Vitality, increasing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

4.name: Ice Fortress
4.description:
Wrap a thick cloak of ice around you and your grouped allies. The ice grants Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r for |cffffff30|r seconds.

You gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff30|r seconds.

5.name: Reviving Barrier
5.description:
Invoke defensive tactics to protect yourself and nearby group members with wards that each absorb up to |cffffff29608|r damage for |cffffff30|r seconds.

The wards also heal you and your group members for |cffffff12195|r Health over |cffffff15|r seconds.
